mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.title,d.item_desc AS description,d.city,d.trip_type,d.expect_price,d.deadline,d.created_at FROM t_demands d JOIN t_profiles p ON p.id=d.publisher_id WHERE d.status='open' AND d.visibility='public' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.banned_until IS NULL OR p.banned_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (d.deadline IS NULL OR d.deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id,s.caption,s.media_kind,s.media_url,s.poster_url,s.created_at, p.nickname AS author_name,p.avatar_url AS author_avatar FROM t_social_posts s JOIN t_profiles p ON p.id=s.author_id WHERE s.status='approved' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.banned_until IS NULL OR p.banned_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_role,carrier_verify_status,buyer_verify_status,enterprise_verify_status FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id,d.title,d.item_desc AS description,d.city,d.trip_type,d.expect_price,d.created_at,r.status FROM t_portal_demand_reviews r JOIN t_demands d ON d.id=r.demand_id WHERE r.status='pending_review' ORDER BY r.created_at,d.id LIMIT 100

SELECT id,owner_id,destination,origin_city,depart_date,return_date,transport_mode,trip_type, capacity_qty,verify_status,proof_urls,visa_proof_urls,ticket_proof_urls,created_at FROM t_trips WHERE verify_status='pending' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100
SELECT id,author_id,caption,media_kind,media_url,poster_url,status,created_at FROM t_social_posts WHERE status='pending_review' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100
